request.description: One borrower profile, with `kyc`: `panHolder` is the PAN type this profile needs (`P` person for individuals and proprietors, `F` firm, `C` company, `E` LLP; `null` until the business type is set) and `pan` is the PAN on record (`masked`, `verified`, `verifiedAt`) or `null`. Borrower context (the applicant's own records, reached through their login); partner context sees applications its firm filed (M3c). Lists and reads never show other people's records.
